import numpy as np, polars as pl
rng = np.random.default_rng(1)
n, d = 300_000, 50
k = rng.integers(0, 8, n)
centers = rng.normal(0, 5, (8, d))
X = (centers[k] + rng.normal(0, 1, (n, d))).astype('float32')
big = pl.DataFrame({f'f{i}': X[:, i] for i in range(d)}).with_columns(pl.Series('group', [f'g{v}' for v in k]), pl.Series('score', X[:, 0] - X[:, 1]))
del X

steps.name: hover
steps.eval: const xy = a['anchorXY']; a['onPointer']({ x: 300, y: 200, world: [xy[0], xy[1]] })
